_comment: Shape reference for site/projects.local.json, which is gitignored.
Copy this to projects.local.json and put your private links in it.
Every entry here must be public:false -- anything public:true belongs in
site/projects.json instead, where the landing page can render it.

projects.name: Example private link
projects.blurb: Something whose URL identifies an account, or that only resolves on your own machine.
projects.note: category decides the dashboard column. Any string works; the dashboard derives its columns from the data.
